requirements.title: KIND argument admissible type and rank
requirements.definition: X may be any intrinsic type and may be scalar or an array.
requirements.oracle:
Source registration only. Future fixtures use exact integer, logical, character, shape, kind, and bit-pattern observations, and use real values only for exact operations or standard inquiry-model values. Every positive plan establishes a non-default state first, uses a conforming companion for zero, .FALSE., or blank results that could otherwise be vacuous, and includes a feature mutation such as changing the intrinsic name, argument order, KIND, DIM, SIZE, or SHIFT value. Unnumbered argument shall-restrictions are source-control restrictions only and are not promoted to diagnostic facets. Bit-result intrinsic plans observe selected bits with BTEST or BOZ-pattern comparison rather than relying on numeric interpretation of a leftmost bit.
